instruction: Add all the Chrome browser extensions from the plugin recommendation document on the Desktop to your Chrome browser.

expected: Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing all 5 Chrome extensions listed in the document. The evaluator checks that all expected extensions (Zoom Chrome Extension, Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader, React Developer Tools, Momentum, Google Translate) are present in Chrome's installed extensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts installed extension names from Chrome Preferences file
Metric properly uses subset comparison to verify all expected extensions are present
Data flow is semantically correct: list of installed names → subset check against expected names
Logic allows for additional extensions beyond the required 5, which is correct behavior
All 5 required extensions from the instruction are verified
Edge case handling: returns 0 if no extensions are installed
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Exact string matching could fail if extension names have slight variations (e.g., trademark symbols, different capitalization). Consider fuzzy matching if this becomes an issue in practice.
The evaluator reads from Chrome's Preferences file which persists across browser restarts, so no postconfig is needed despite the static validation warning.
